description: This file contains implementation of classes and functions related to GLSL shader variable types, including uniforms, varyings, interface blocks, and work group sizes, used in shader translation and validation within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: ShaderVariable
classes.description: Represents a GLSL shader variable, including uniforms, varyings, and attributes, with methods for comparison, size calculation, and name resolution.

classes.name: InterfaceBlock
classes.description: Represents a GLSL interface block, including its fields, layout, and binding information, with methods for comparison and naming.

classes.name: WorkGroupSize
classes.description: Encapsulates the size of a compute shader work group, with methods for setting, validating, and comparing sizes.

methods.name: GetNonAuxiliaryInterpolationType
methods.description: Returns the non-auxiliary interpolation type, converting centroid to smooth if needed.

methods.name: InterpolationTypesMatch
methods.description: Checks if two interpolation types match, considering auxiliary qualifiers.

methods.description: Constructor initializing a ShaderVariable with default values.

methods.description: Equality comparison for ShaderVariable.

methods.description: Sets the array size of the variable.

methods.description: Calculates the product of inner array sizes.

methods.name: ShaderVariable::getArraySizeProduct
methods.description: Returns the total array size product.

methods.description: Indexes into an array variable, updating offset and removing the last dimension.

methods.name: ShaderVariable::getNestedArraySize
methods.description: Returns the size of a nested array dimension.

methods.name: ShaderVariable::getBasicTypeElementCount
methods.description: Returns the count of basic type elements, considering arrays.

methods.description: Calculates the external memory size of the variable.

methods.description: Finds variable info by its mapped name, returning the leaf variable and original name.

methods.description: Checks if the variable is an emulated built-in.

methods.name: ShaderVariable::isSameVariableAtLinkTime
methods.description: Checks if two variables are the same at link time, considering type, precision, name, arrays, layout, and fields.

methods.name: ShaderVariable::isSameUniformAtLinkTime
methods.description: Checks if two uniform variables are the same at link time, considering binding, image format, location, offset, and access qualifiers.

methods.name: ShaderVariable::isSameInterfaceBlockFieldAtLinkTime
methods.description: Checks if interface block fields are the same at link time.

methods.name: ShaderVariable::isSameVaryingAtLinkTime
methods.description: Checks if varyings are the same at link time, considering interpolation, invariance, location, and name.

methods.name: ShaderVariable::isSameVaryingAtLinkTime
